asr.full_text: What's up everyone? I'm back at the office for another day of error reading fun. Oh good, you are finally here Sam. You are needed once again. Uh, what for Mike? It turns out that there is a massive need for a new tech support unit. Since we don't have anyone qualified for the position, we have to resort to using you. But you have Scotty. He will try to upsell Bologna sandwiches. What about bacon? No. Don't get me started on him. Say that... one more time. Bacon is trying to say you back in the bacon. With more your bacon ends you need to bacon it with a bacon,. Bacon in the bacon, and to finish it up, you just bacon the bacon. I can't understand a goddamn word you're saying. What about Dr. Graffs? Too busy with his Graffs 101 crap. Which reminds me, I am running late for that seminar. Just... Ah. Don't screw around, alright? Sure thing, no problem, Mike. Great. I'll be back in 15 minutes. Sam, wake up! You've been sleeping for 9 hours! You missed 245 calls! Oh god! No! I didn't mean it! Haha, the look on your face was priceless. You actually missed zero calls and you were only out for a few minutes. Get the fuck out of my office or I will shoot your fucking circuits out. Okay, geez, why do you have to be so rude while he can take a joke like... Wow. Rude. Oh boy, it is my first call. Hello, and thank you for calling. Uh. I don't know what tech support company this is. Ahem. Thanks for calling the Diarrhea Dump Tech Support, where we satisfy your shitty needs with shitty service. Just kidding, we don't have shitty service. How may I help you? Yes I, I'd like two number nines. A number nine large. A number six with extra dip. A number seven. Two number 45s, one with cheese, and a large soda. And I'd like that for delivery, please. Excuse me, who the hell are you, and why are you calling this tech support hotline? Excuse me, but this is the KFC that is located at 1094 Sunset Parkway, right? What the? There is no such road in our area called Sunset Parkway. And this isn't a fucking KFC. God damn it! I placed an order and you are refusing to take it? Put your manager on the phone or else I will have to call the police on you! Ha, yeah, jokes on you! I am the boss! You are lying! And just for the record, I put all of the cop cars in jail! You did what now? The city must pay me to get a cop car! And I don't pay taxes because of it! Okay, uh-huh. I am going to get off the... Don't threaten me! Sir, I am not! Don't threaten me. I'm sorry sir, but I am not. Don't you dare fucking threaten me! Wow, this guy has an abluse or something. Sir, are you there? Hi. Jesus Christ! So, you ready for a fun night tonight? Well, that first call was... a hem. Interesting. Anyway, it is time for me to go back to my. Nice, sweet, relaxing nap. Oh for fuck's sake. Thank you for calling LeakyBunk tech support. How may we help you? Microsoft Sam. This is Grover Fetchwell from the processing division of the Dogpatch County Sheriff's Office. Now, since you have failed to appeal to a hearing on one of our client's cases, we will have no choice but to come to either your place of residence or business to personally serve you. If we can't serve you in 24 hours, we will confiscate and liquidate all of your assets. You have been notified. Wow. A scam. And not a very smart one at that. Like seriously, do they really believe that I will fall for that bullshit? I'd have to be stupider than Scotty on crack. Wait. Scratch that stupider than bacon on crack. And that is being generous. Oh boy, my food is here. Hello, thanks for taking the time to deliver my food. Get him, guys! Who said it is the children? No no no no no-. Oh no! It is time to stop. Seriously. It is time to stop. I've had enough of your bullshit. Why the hell do you put me through this? I don't care. I don't like it. I don't want it. I don't need it. Fuck off. Sorry about that guys. I just got a little pissy with some of the people that tried to swap me. Can this day get any worse? Hello, and thank you calling Slap That Top Com tech support. What would you need to slap some sense into today? Oh hey there. How is it going, Sam at NKRS 200? Oh great, Mr. Know-it-all. Scythe, how may I help you? Excuse me, but that is not how you'd address a customer. Okay, I'm sorry. I've been having a crappy day today. It's been scam call after scam call after scam call. So, what may I help you with? Okay, so, I am having problems with my MacBook Pro keyboard. The keys stop working after I even look at them or if I touch them once. I can't even access anything on the dock anymore because of this. Wait. What operating system are you talking about? The words you are using sound so foreign to me. I mean, the first part I understand, but then the rest of it is like some made-up garbage. This is using Mac OS Catalina. Oh. Now I see the problem. Here is what you should do and follow my support steps very carefully. In the keyboard, you should see the power button. Press it and hold it for 15 seconds. Then close the lid and send the damn thing back to Apple. Get the money for a refund and buy yourself a Surface Pro 7. I am not getting a damn Surface Pro 7! Especially when Windows 10 has update problems. All I want is the keyboard to be fixed. Apple is offering a replacement program. Just go to them. They will replace it with another faulty keyboard that will break if you breathe on it wrong. If you don't want to have it fixed, then you are shut out of luck until the next MacBook comes out next year. With a better keyboard design. A design that will not break if you just exhale on it softly. It's revolutionary breaking and crumbling is the future. Alright, I'm done dealing with you. Wow. Rude. Thank you for calling the PaceTall technical support hotline. How may I help you? Can I have my hair, that was in the comments box of one of your extremely older videos featured in a new video? No. Fuck off. Damn kids. Thanks for calling Colorform Technical Support. How may we silence your problems today? So, I have an issue with my computer. It won't boot. Okay, first thing, is it powered in? Yes it is. Okay. Turn it off and back on. Okay. Now I just see a flashing cursor on the screen. Wait, what else is on the screen? It just says C colon N N a greater than sign with a flashing cursor next to it. Wait a minute. You must be in DOS. Type in the following. Wait, I don't have a keyboard. Well, I am sorry to say this, but you are shit out of luck. Somebody using DOS in 2020. Wow. Just... wow. Sigh. Hello, you have reached the voicemail box of 1-800-KISS-MY-ASS. At the tone, please record your message. When you have finished recording, please hang up or press 1 for more options. To leave a callback number, press 5. P-T-T-T-T-T-T-T-T-T-T-T-T-T-T-T-T-T-T-T-T-T-T-T-T-T-T-T. Ugh, I hate these damn things. Hey Sam, I know you're probably on lunch or something, but... Just wanna let you know I may have found your boss, however, he isn't... Oh, what's the word I'm looking for? In the same physical state as you'd expect. Anyway, call me back when you get this, please. Thanks. Wait, Double T, no. Fuck. I wanted to know more. Oh, that is probably him. Hello, Double T. You got info in my boss? No, not you. You. Sam, are you there? Sam, what the hell? Are you alright? Hello, Sam? Are you alright? Sam, are you there? Are you there, Sam? Are you there? Ugh. Where the hell am I? Oh, thank God. Sam, you had a heart attack. I had a heart attack? Sorry, that is my ringtone. Why in the fuck would you have a ringtone like that? Anyway, I'm going to let you take the next couple of weeks off. You deserved it. You need time to recover. Thanks, Mike. Oh, and one more thing. You are fired. You caused us to get negative reviews once again. Wait what? Let me see them. I told you the police cars belong to me. You have not paid your tax . They never helped me! Sammy... Where is Ryan? One from Loudon, you're a goat, one from Bolton, one from Huffington,. Wilk, Merge, Down, Coates, and F Jones,. Knappage from Ross, and Neoff, and Remridge,. Pat, Kaps, and Lund, and Cork, and Smink,. K.O., and Don, Jack, and Foff, and C. His first joke on the podcast... They grow up so fast. Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa. Okay, that fucking does it. I left you in charge of making sure he is okay, and you fucking blew your chance. Get the fuck out of my hospital. But, but, but... Get out now. Wow... What an asshole... And... he is out. Great. Now I have to wait until Sam gets out of a coma. Wait a minute, what the fuck are you doing, Scotty? He is only unconscious, it is not necessary to do that, noooooooooooo... It's time to play the game. I'm going to play the game in the game. I'm going to play the game in the game. You've reached the AXIS voicemail box for Microsoft SIM. At the tone, please tell me who you are, what number you're calling from, and why you're calling. Hello? Hello, hello? Well, if you're hearing this, then I just want to say that I'm alright. I am perfectly safe everyone, but something is wrong with me. I am completely different. I don't know what has happened to me, but I have changed. Not a turn into a leaf type change, but more of a life-local type of change. No idea. I am now a... A... A... A body... Bye.
